reviewer_static_findings.finding: W is called camera rotation plus translation inside a 2x2 covariance formula; J is said to be evaluated at screen-space mu-prime, while later prose says mu. Dimensions/evaluation point are insufficiently specified. Both conflicting statements are preserved.

reviewer_static_findings.finding: The learned depth affects output only through argsort indices; no differentiable numeric path from depth to loss is supplied. Tile assignment and ordering are discrete choices. The translation correctly preserves, rather than independently validates, the source fully-differentiable assertion.

reviewer_static_findings.finding: The package implements a dense 2D rasterizer/trainable scene and a complete degree-3 SH basis, not the complete 3D projection/SfM/tile CUDA/densification/export pipeline. reviewer_static_findings.suggested_action: Keep source-scope and implementation differences explicit outside translation; do not claim a missing complete SH implementation or executed 3D pipeline.
